title: Dr Aisyah (GP, Tanavu)
description: Persona: a general practitioner in Tanavu, empanelled by the national pilgrimage authority for pre-pilgrimage health examinations; the guide's Counsellor. Fictional.

persona.name: Dr Aisyah
persona.goal: Send her pilgrims fit to travel, with their consent understood and their record ready.
needs: A clear account of what the Pilgrimage Health Record is, who sees it and for how long
To know what happened to her patients abroad
frustrations: Hearing nothing back after the season
